headline: Curated Discovery, Safety & Playful Learning
summary: Hands-on STEM adventures, creative reading guides, and family-friendly digital habits built for young explorers.

advice.title: Build a 20-Minute Curiosity Routine
advice.guidance: Pick one hands-on puzzle, nature observation, or science experiment each afternoon before screen playtime.
advice.actionStep: Write down one question you want to explore today and test it with a parent or guardian.

advice.title: Three-Jar Allowance Habit
advice.guidance: Split weekly chore or gift money into Spend, Save, and Share jars to see small goals grow visually.
advice.actionStep: Drop your next coins into the Save jar toward a favorite book or craft kit.

advice.title: Kind & Safe Online Play
advice.guidance: Keep full names, home addresses, and school details private, and ask a trusted adult before joining any new game.
advice.actionStep: Review your favorite game privacy settings together with a family member.
